scripts.text:
[Equipment Reform PR Agent]
Hello, adventurer!
Are you unhappy with your equipment now?
Don't you want to try a new modification than just any other normal method?
Join the Regenschirm Institute!
scripts.translation:
[裝備改造宣傳員]
你好，冒險者！
你對現在的裝備不滿意嗎？
難道不想嘗試一種不同於普通方法的改造方式嗎？
加入雷根修蘆研究所吧！

scripts.text: Let's go.
scripts.translation: 我們走。

scripts.text: Listen to the explanation.
scripts.translation: 聽一下說明

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Equipment Reform PR Agent]
Good! Other facilities in the institute are confidential and are not accessible, so we will guide you on a special path where you outsiders can enter!
scripts.translation:
[裝備改造宣傳員]
很好！研究所的其他設施屬於機密，無法進入，所以我們會引導你走一條只有外部人員才能進入的專用通道！

scripts.text:
[Equipment Reform PR Agent]
All around the world research is being conducted at the Regenschirm Institute to modify weapons, armor, accessories and other equipment items...
We're still collecting data and researching modifications, so we need a lot of adventurer's equipment to increase our modification research.
scripts.translation:
[裝備改造宣傳員]
目前，世界各地都在雷根修蘆研究所進行武器、防具、飾品及其他裝備的改造研究...
我們仍在收集資料並研究改造方法，因此需要大量冒險者的裝備來增加改造研究的樣本。

scripts.text:
[Equipment Reform PR Agent]
Research is ongoing, so please look forward to the addition of multiple new equipment as soon as it is completed!
scripts.translation:
[裝備改造宣傳員]
研究正在進行中，請期待研究完成後新增的多種裝備！

scripts.text:
[Equipment Reform PR Agent]
If you're interested later, come back!
scripts.translation:
[裝備改造宣傳員]
如果你以後感興趣，歡迎隨時回來！

scripts.text:
[Torus]
Huh? Do you have anyone else to see on our team other than the team leader?
Then that's me~
I am in charge of Enchants.
Let's see what you got?
scripts.translation:
[托魯斯]
咦？除了隊長之外，你們團隊還有其他人要見嗎？
那就是我啦~
我負責附魔研究。
讓我看看你有什麼？

scripts.text: Modified OS Weapon Enchant
scripts.translation: 改造OS武器附魔

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Torus]
Come back whenever you need it.
And we need the research.
scripts.translation:
[托魯斯]
需要的時候隨時回來。
而且我們需要這些研究資料。

scripts.text:
[Torus]
Where...
scripts.translation:
[托魯斯]
哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Frasa]
Let's see... You're a guest.
I like people who are sure what they want.
Modifiable items can also be read as <TIPBOX>[List]<INFO>9163</INFO></TIPBOX>.
I will try to answer any questions you have.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉薩]
讓我看看...你是客人。
我喜歡目標明確的人。
可改造的物品列表可以在<TIPBOX>[列表]<INFO>9163</INFO></TIPBOX>中檢視。
我會盡力回答你的任何問題。

scripts.text: Thanos Weapons
scripts.translation: 塔諾斯武器

scripts.text: OS Weapons
scripts.translation: OS武器

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Frasa]
^0000FFThanos weapon^000000 mods have lower and intermediate levels in the modification method.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉薩]
^0000FF塔諾斯武器^000000的改造分為低階和中級兩種方法。

scripts.text: Lower mods
scripts.translation: 低階改造

scripts.text: Intermediate mods
scripts.translation: 中級改造

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Frasa]
Thanos weapon lower modification.
^FF0000Refine level is reduced by 5^000000, but consumes less materials.
And for mods, the weapon needs to be refine level +9 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉薩]
塔諾斯武器低階改造。
^FF0000強化等級降低5級^000000，但消耗的材料較少。
且進行改造時，武器需要達到+9強化等級。

scripts.text:
[Frasa]
Thanos Weapon intermediate modification.
^FF0000Refine level is reduced by 1^000000, but consumes more material.
And for mods, the weapon needs to be refine level +9 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉薩]
塔諾斯武器中級改造。
^FF0000強化等級降低1級^000000，但消耗的材料較多。
且進行改造時，武器需要達到+9強化等級。

scripts.text:
[Frasa]
If you need mods, come back.
You are welcome any time you help us with our research.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉薩]
如果需要改造，歡迎隨時回來。
只要你能幫助我們進行研究，我們隨時歡迎你的到來。

scripts.text:
[Frasa]
^0000FFOS Weapons^000000...
For modification, the refine level must be +7 or higher.
Refine level does not decrease.
Did you bring the stuff?
scripts.translation:
[弗拉薩]
^0000FFOS武器^000000...
進行改造時，強化等級必須達到+7以上。
強化等級不會降低。
你帶材料了嗎？

scripts.text: Convert
scripts.translation: 轉換

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Frasa]
If you need mods, come back.
You are welcome any time you help us with our research.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉薩]
如果需要改造，歡迎隨時回來。
只要你能幫助我們進行研究，我們隨時歡迎你的到來。

scripts.text:
[Frasa]
Let's see what you brought.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉薩]
讓我看看你帶了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Frasa]
If you need mods, come back.
You are welcome any time you help us with our research.
scripts.translation:
[弗拉薩]
如果需要改造，歡迎隨時回來。
只要你能幫助我們進行研究，我們隨時歡迎你的到來。

scripts.text:
[Algebra]
Ah, we've come this far, but our team's research is still lacking in experiments.
I'll improve it a bit next time and get the captain's permission, then let's proceed.
Okay?
scripts.translation:
[阿爾傑布拉]
啊，雖然我們已經走到這一步了，但團隊的研究實驗仍然不足。
下次我會稍微改進一下，並徵得船長的許可，然後再繼續。
好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Grid]
Come on.
It's a low-budget lab, so it's always like this.
My assistants and I refine the gemstones used in this lab. For a fee.
scripts.translation:
[格里德]
來吧。
這是個低預算的實驗室，所以總是這樣。
我和我的助手們在這裡精煉寶石原石。需要收取費用。

scripts.text: View the exchange list
scripts.translation: 檢視兌換列表

scripts.text: What are you exchanging?
scripts.translation: 你在兌換什麼？

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Grid]
Let's see...
Now there are these things.
scripts.translation:
[格里德]
讓我看看...
現在有這些東西。

scripts.text: Gemstone refining
scripts.translation: 寶石原石精煉

scripts.text: Top ore exchange
scripts.translation: 頂級礦石兌換

scripts.text: Buy additional ore
scripts.translation: 購買額外礦石

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Grid]
Gemstone refining.
scripts.translation:
[格里德]
寶石原石精煉。

scripts.text:
[Grid]
Top ore exchange.
scripts.translation:
[格里德]
頂級礦石兌換。

scripts.text:
[Grid]
Don't have enough ore? Then there's something I'm specifically collecting...
Do you have a shadow decon?
scripts.translation:
[格里德]
礦石不夠嗎？那我正在專門收集一些東西...
你有暗影分解嗎？

scripts.text:
[Grid]
If you need anything, come again.
scripts.translation:
[格里德]
如果你需要什麼，隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Grid]
As we see in our research, the materials are very rare. There are adventurers hired by our team, but the material is not comparable to the amount we need.
So when the adventurers came with the materials, they decided to provide the corresponding research value.
scripts.translation:
[格里德]
正如我們在研究中看到的，材料非常稀有。雖然我們有僱傭的冒險者，但材料數量遠不能滿足我們的需求。
所以當冒險者帶著材料來的時候，他們決定提供相應的研究價值。

scripts.text:
[Grid]
Luckily, we do the research and adventurers who come to us provide materials to use our technology.
If you want to modify something you only need to bring the presented materials.
scripts.translation:
[格里德]
幸運的是，我們進行研究，而來到這裡的冒險者提供材料以使用我們的技術。
如果你想改造什麼，只需要帶上所需的材料即可。

scripts.text:
[Grid]
You're an adventurer, so you know what that means?
scripts.translation:
[格里德]
你是冒險者，所以你知道這意味著什麼嗎？

scripts.text:
[Grid]
If you need anything, come again.
scripts.translation:
[格里德]
如果你需要什麼，隨時再來。

scripts.text:
[Champ]
Finally, I talked to an adventurer and asked him to confirm my research, was that you?
Unfortunately, our team hasn't done enough to get out there yet.
scripts.translation:
[冠軍]
終於，我和一位冒險者交談，並請他確認了我的研究，是你嗎？
不幸的是，我們的團隊還沒有做好走出去的準備。

scripts.text:
[Champ]
It's still incomplete.
I'll see you next time I get permission from the captain.
scripts.translation:
[冠軍]
它仍然不完整。
等我下次得到船長的許可後再見。

scripts.text:
[Stack]
See Team Licht's performance?
We're proud of this lab.
Which one do you want to modify?
Modifiable items are located in <TIPBOX>[List]<INFO>9166</INFO></TIPBOX>.
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
看到Team Licht的表現了嗎？
我們為這個實驗室感到自豪。
你想改造哪一個？
可改造物品位於<TIPBOX>[列表]<INFO>9166</INFO></TIPBOX>。

scripts.text: Non-standard armor
scripts.translation: 非標準防具

scripts.text: Non-standard weapon
scripts.translation: 非標準武器

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Stack]
^0000FFNon-standard armor^000000, there are Lower, Intermediate, and Upper levels of the modification method.
Non-refineable armor is only capable of Upper modification.
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
^0000FF非標準防具^000000的改造方法分為低階、中級和高階。
不可精煉的防具只能進行高階改造。

scripts.text: Lower mods
scripts.translation: 低階改造

scripts.text: Intermediate mods
scripts.translation: 中級改造

scripts.text: Upper mods
scripts.translation: 高階改造

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Stack]
Armor Lower Mods? Okay.
^FF0000Refine level is reduced by 5^000000, but consumes less material.
And for modification, the equipment must have a refine level of +9 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
防具低階改造？好的。
^FF0000精煉等級降低5級^000000，但消耗的材料較少。
且改造要求裝備的精煉等級在+9以上。

scripts.text:
[Stack]
Armor Intermediate Mods? Okay.
^FF0000Refine level is reduced by 1^000000, but consumes more material.
And for modification, the equipment must have a refine level of +9 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
防具中級改造？好的。
^FF0000精煉等級降低1級^000000，但消耗的材料較多。
且改造要求裝備的精煉等級在+9以上。

scripts.text:
[Stack]
Armor Upper Mods? Okay.
^FF0000Refine level increases by 1^000000, but consumes more material.
And for modification, the equipment must have a refine level of +9 or higher.
^FF0000Non-refineable equipment^000000 can also be granted with advanced modifications, but the refine level does not increase.
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
防具高階改造？好的。
^FF0000精煉等級提升1級^000000，但消耗的材料較多。
且改造要求裝備的精煉等級在+9以上。
^FF0000不可精煉的裝備^000000也可以進行高階改造，但精煉等級不會提升。

scripts.text:
[Stack]
Already going?
You need to see more of our outstanding performance!
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
這就走了？
你還沒看到我們出色的表現呢！

scripts.text:
[Stack]
^0000FFNon-standard weapon^000000, there are Lower, Intermediate, and Upper levels of the modification method.
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
^0000FF非標準武器^000000的改造方法分為低階、中級和高階。

scripts.text: Lower mods
scripts.translation: 低階改造

scripts.text: Intermediate mods
scripts.translation: 中級改造

scripts.text: Upper mods
scripts.translation: 高階改造

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Stack]
Weapon Lower Mods? Okay.
^FF0000Refine level is reduced by 5^000000, but consumes less material.
And for modification, the equipment must have a refine level of +9 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
武器低階改造？好的。
^FF0000精煉等級降低5級^000000，但消耗的材料較少。
且改造要求裝備的精煉等級在+9以上。

scripts.text:
[Stack]
Weapon Intermediate Mods? Okay.
^FF0000Refine level is reduced by 1^000000, but consumes more material.
And for modification, the equipment must have a refine level of +9 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
武器中級改造？好的。
^FF0000精煉等級降低1級^000000，但消耗的材料較多。
且改造要求裝備的精煉等級在+9以上。

scripts.text:
[Stack]
Weapon Advanced Mods? Okay.
^FF0000Refine level increases by 1^000000, but consumes more material.
And for modification, the equipment must have a refine level of +9 or higher.
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
武器高階改造？好的。
^FF0000精煉等級提升1級^000000，但消耗的材料較多。
且改造要求裝備的精煉等級在+9以上。

scripts.text:
[Stack]
Already going?
You need to see more of our outstanding performance!
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
這就走了？
你還沒看到我們出色的表現呢！

scripts.text:
[Stack]
Already going?
You need to see more of our outstanding performance!
scripts.translation:
[斯塔克]
這就走了？
你還沒看到我們出色的表現呢！

scripts.text:
[Director]
...Come on.
You may have heard the explanation when you came, but to briefly introduce you to this place, there is still a long way to go. We are working on converting many weapons, armor, accessories, etc. into something different.
scripts.translation:
[總監]
...來吧。
你來的時候可能聽過介紹，但要讓你完全瞭解這個地方，還有很長的路要走。我們正在致力於將許多武器、防具、飾品等改造成不同的形態。

scripts.text:
[Director]
It is essential to cut the refine of the equipment to be converted, but it is a labor for greater power.
scripts.translation:
[總監]
改造裝備時必須削減其精煉等級，但這是一種為了獲得更強力量而付出的勞動。

scripts.text:
[Director]
Research is ongoing, so it is not known when and where something will suddenly be completed and offered to adventurers.
It is... As soon as the data is collected, it will be somehow.
scripts.translation:
[總監]
研究正在進行中，所以不知道何時何地會有新的成果突然完成並提供給冒險者。
這...一旦資料收集完畢，就會以某種形式呈現。

scripts.text:
[Director]
And this time, Team Licht achieved it.
If you're interested, check out what research was done.
scripts.translation:
[總監]
這一次，Team Licht團隊取得了成功。
如果你感興趣，可以看看他們做了哪些研究。

scripts.text:
[Director]
Everyone likes it quiet, so don't talk too loud.
scripts.translation:
[總監]
大家都喜歡安靜，所以請不要大聲喧譁。

scripts.text:
[Exit guard]
Are you done?
^FF0000Return to Lighthalzen^000000?
scripts.translation:
[出口衛兵]
你完成了嗎？
^FF0000返回裡希塔樂鎮^000000？

scripts.text: Return.
scripts.translation: 返回

scripts.text: Work remaining.
scripts.translation: 還有工作要做

scripts.text:
[Exit guard]
Please tell us at any time when you are finished.
scripts.translation:
[出口衛兵]
請隨時告知我們您已完成工作。

scripts.text:
[Exit guard]
Let me guide you on the way back.
scripts.translation:
[出口衛兵]
我來指引您返回的路。

scripts.text:
[Exit guard]
Are you done?
^FF0000Return to Item Mall^000000?
scripts.translation:
[出口衛兵]
您完成了嗎？
^FF0000返回物品商城^000000？

scripts.text: Return.
scripts.translation: 返回

Please tell us at any time when you are finished.
scripts.translation:
[出口衛兵]
請隨時告知我們您已完成工作。

scripts.text:

Let me guide you on the way back.

我來指引您返回的路。
